answer: What survives to the voyage is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
